title: Maximal ideals in the finitary symmetric group algebra in characteristic two
summary: In 1996, Baranov and Kleshchev classified maximal ideals in the finitary symmetric group algebra over fields of characteristic not 2. The corresponding question in characteristic~2 has remained open since. In the current paper we solve the problem by establishing part of a conjectural connection between prime ideals in this group algebra and the recently defined higher Verlinde categories. To achieve this we investigate thick tensor ideals of tilting modules of the general linear group in characteristic 2.
